name: io.github.Kyrzin/kybase
title: Kybase
description: Self-hosted Markdown memory for AI agents: notes you can read and edit, with hybrid search.

environmentVariables.name: KYBASE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the embedded database and instance secret live. Defaults to ~/.kybase

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama endpoint for local embeddings. Without any provider, full-text search still works

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google API key, when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=google. Sends note text to Google

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai. Sends note text to OpenAI

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Use an existing Kybase Postgres instead of the embedded one (migrations are left to the app)
